{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Group by channel and sum revenue
total_revenue_by_channel = df.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()

# Identify the channel with the highest revenue
highest_revenue_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.loc[total_revenue_by_channel['revenue'].idxmax()]['channel']

# Print the total revenue per channel
print(total_revenue_by_channel)

# Return the highest revenue channel
highest_revenue_channel"}
